dropdown interaction

Motion·by @dejvdesign·2026-08-28·inspora page·original post

What it is

Label-picker dropdown: '+ Label' opens a menu with a search field, checkbox rows of labels with color dots, and a create flow - typing 'design' offers 'Create new label' which opens a color-pick submenu (Coral/Amber/Mint/Azure/Lilac/Rose/Teal); selected labels become chips that animate into the parent row.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-15%
Row of label chips (Handoff, Motion) + '+ Label' button; dropdown opens below with search input 'Add or find a label...' and checkbox list (Accessibility, Copy, Handoff, Motion, Research, Visual QA) - checked ones ticked.
15-30%
Typing 'design' filters the list empty and shows '+ Create new label: design'.
30-45%
Create flow advances to a color submenu: 'Pick a color' rows with dots (Coral, Amber, Mint, Azure, Lilac, Rose, Teal), hover highlight.

60-85%
Toggling more checkboxes: chips appear/disappear in the row in real time, unchecked chip exits with fade+shrink.
85-100%
Final state: Accessibility + design checked; dropdown closes on outside click.

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: a label-picker dropdown - "+ Label" opens a menu with search, checkbox rows of labels with color dots, and a create flow: typing "design" offers "Create new label", which opens a color-pick submenu; selected labels become chips that animate into the parent row.

## Stack
React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Framer Motion (AnimatePresence for dropdown + chips, layout animations for the chip row). Animate transform and opacity only.

## Scene
Row of label chips (Handoff, Motion) + a "+ Label" button. Dropdown below: search input ("Add or find a label..."), checkbox list (Accessibility, Copy, Handoff, Motion, Research, Visual QA) each with color dot; checked rows ticked. Create flow: "+ Create new label: design" -> "Pick a color" submenu (Coral, Amber, Mint, Azure, Lilac, Rose, Teal) with dot rows and hover highlight.

## Motion spec
Pattern: popover with submenu and live chip sync.
- Dropdown opens: opacity 0 -> 1, scale 0.96 -> 1 origin-top, 180ms ease-out.
- Typing filters the list live; empty result reveals the create item.
- Create -> submenu slides over (x 8 -> 0, 200ms), replacing the list in the same panel.
- Color chosen: "design" chip materializes in the parent row (pop-in 150ms spring); sibling chips shift with layout animation; the list now shows design checked.
- Checkbox toggles: chips appear/disappear in the row in real time - enter pop 150ms, exit fade+shrink 150ms.
- Outside click closes the dropdown (150ms fade).

## Calibration
- Dropdown 180ms, submenu slide 200ms, chip pop 150ms - snappy micro-interaction band.
- Chips animate with layout so the row reflows organically; never absolute-position chips in.
- Submenu slides within the same panel bounds - no second popover floating offset.

## Reduced motion
All transitions 150ms opacity only; chips appear without pop or reflow animation.

## Don't miss
- Chip state and checkbox state are one source of truth, synced in real time both directions.
- The create item appears only when the filter has no match, labeled with the typed text.
- Search field is focused on open - the flow is keyboard-first.
